name: JoJo Hailey
description:
'''Joel Lamont Hailey''' (born June 10, 1971), known professionally as '''JoJo''', is an American singer and songwriter, known for being a lead vocalist of the R&B groups [[Jodeci]] and [[K-Ci & JoJo]], both of which spawned platinum and multiplatinum albums. Hailey wrote the latter group's [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] number one hit, "[[All My Life (K-Ci & JoJo song)|All My Life]]", and was nominated at the [[41st Annual Grammy Awards]] for [[Grammy Award for Best R&B Song|Best R&B Song]].

Hailey started releasing music as a solo artist in 2020 with "Special", later remixed to feature [[Snoop Dogg]].
